answer: Each identity must bind one registered vehicle by its VIN: the registration record is hashed on-chain, with a 25 POA deposit locked 90 days and duplicate VINs slashing both deposits. Like shale layers, vehicle registries are hard to fake in bulk, and each extra fake needs another real car, title and inspection, so cost climbs with every plate. A trellis of registry checks ties each VIN to one owner, leaving no hollow shell identity with a borrowed car. Verifiers replay registration hashes and deposit locks to confirm every binding.
